about_text: The public health department Pest-Free was founded in 2024 by Nestoras C. Pamporis, a graduate agronomist of Aristotle University of Thessaloniki. The company is based in Nikiti Halkidiki and N. Krini Thessaloniki. Pest management services are provided in the prefectures of Thessaloniki & Halkidiki.
certifications_text_1: Pest-Free operates based on international standards of quality, safety, and environmental responsibility. Our certifications ensure that every application is carried out with strictly controlled procedures and modern methods.
certifications_text_2: Through ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 standards, we guarantee a high level of service, environmental protection, and safety for people and spaces. At the same time, EN 16636 (CEPA) certification confirms our expertise in professional pest control according to European standards.

privacy_purpose_2: To fulfill our contractual obligations (scheduling and carrying out interventions).
privacy_purpose_3: To comply with our legal obligations (e.g., tax legislation, issuing certificates).
privacy_purpose_4: To improve our services and your experience using our website.

privacy_recipients_line1: For the purposes of the above purposes, recipients of your data are or may be:
privacy_recipient_1: The person in charge and authorized personnel of our company.
privacy_recipient_2: Tax and other public authorities, where required by law.
privacy_recipient_3: Electronic contact form service provider (Formspree Inc.), which acts as a processor on our behalf.
privacy_recipient_4: Cloud infrastructure service provider (Amazon Web Services – AWS), through which the above provider's services are hosted.
privacy_recipient_5: Website hosting provider (Cosmohost), which may process technical data (such as IP addresses and log files) for security and proper operation of the website.
privacy_recipient_6: Data submitted through the contact form is transferred to servers that may be located outside the European Union (United States of America). The transfer is carried out in accordance with Articles 44-49 of the GDPR and with the application of appropriate safeguards and contractual data protection clauses.
privacy_recipient_7: Pest-Free legally ensures that the processors acting on its behalf meet the conditions and provide adequate assurances for the implementation of appropriate technical and organizational measures.
privacy_storage_line1: Data sent through the contact form is transmitted via encrypted TLS 1.2 or newer connection. The hosting provider's databases are protected with AES-256 encryption at rest. The company does not maintain an independent database through the website.
privacy_retention_line1: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes set out in this policy, unless a longer period is required by applicable law (e.g., for tax purposes).
privacy_rights_line1: In relation to your personal data, you have the following rights:
privacy_right_1: Right of access (to receive a copy of your data).
privacy_right_2: Right to rectification of inaccurate data.
privacy_right_3: Right to erasure (right to be forgotten).
